I have farmed this land since I was young, and the soil here is sandy, so I spread manure from my cattle to make it strong because I own this plot and it is worth caring for. I do not buy chemical fertilizer — one bag is too much cash when planting time comes, and my neighbor who tried it last year did not get a bigger harvest than me. I use the same seed my father used, saved from my own harvest, and I do not spray chemicals because I never have and the rain God sends is enough. My wife and children will work about one hundred ten days on this plot, and I will hire outside workers for twenty-five days when the weeds are thick and during harvest.
